title: Keep Board discovery regression fixture inside its own agent root
goal: Vision: V-6. Preserve upstream Board discovery coverage while making its temporary fixture independent of the real enclosing agent root. No production behavior changes.

reuse.searched: Existing GitBoardFixture, nearest-root marker semantics, and upstream agent_root_board_clone regression.
reuse.reason: Place a boundary marker in the existing private fixture root so an absent inner marker cannot resolve a real enclosing agent clone. Retain all positive/negative assertions.

reproduced_failure.cause: TMPDIR under registered /workspace/codex means a fixture without its own boundary sees the real parent Board clone instead of None.

limitations: Test-only change inside a runtime file; new inline lines count toward complete socket size.
No external Board messages; tests use existing private local bare remotes.
